usageNotes: Use this to configure the host-level firewall behavior on a specific PVE node — enabling or disabling the firewall, tuning conntrack limits, and adjusting log verbosity. Requires Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node}; settings take effect immediately without a reboot. Pass the digest from get_nodes_node_firewall_options to guard against concurrent modifications, and use the delete param to reset individual settings back to their defaults instead of re-specifying every value.

examples.summary: Enable the node firewall with synflood protection and info-level logging for inbound traffic

tips: To disable the firewall without touching other settings, send only enable=false — all other options are preserved.
nftables is a tech preview; leave it at the default (false) on production nodes.
nf_conntrack_max default is 262144; increase it on high-traffic nodes running many VMs/containers to avoid 'table full' drops.
To reset a specific option (e.g. log_level_in) to its default, pass its name in the delete field rather than guessing the default value.
NDP should remain enabled (default true) on any node using IPv6; disabling it breaks IPv6 neighbor discovery for hosted VMs.
